 By WRAL staff
 Food Lion’s website and app are working again following what
the company described as a cybersecurity incident last week. In a notice on its
app Tuesday, the company confirmed the incident. 
 The Food Lion website and app had been down for nine days.
 Other WRAL Top Stories
 A spokesperson for Food Lion told WRAL that on Sunday
October 11 the company’s website and app were taken down due to a network
issue .
 Customers will receive refunds for orders placed through
FoodLion.com or the Food Lion app that were affected by the outage, Food Lion
said.
 Customers who activated Shop & Earn rewards before the
Oct. 11 outage could continue earning and spending rewards as normal, Food Lion
said.
